blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git
blocks.zh: 即时持续学习通过调取一小组即时符号来适应被冷冻了的先入为主的视变器. 最近,一个瞬间的方法,在所有任务中共享一个单一的瞬间,使这个范式的参数效率最大化。 尚未解决的问题是,共享提示如何在为新课更新的同时保留旧课的知识. 现有方法保护参数空间中的旧知识,它们冻结特定任务的提示,扩展新的组件,或稀有的门,使信使得到梯度。 然而,这种方法牺牲了可塑性,然而,它仍然允许在共同的代号上漂移,可能会破坏催化器在过去的班级上的功能. 必须保存的是提示的行为. 我们提出TEA-Prompt, 夫妇(一) 一种标志性评价模块, 将每个提示性标记分配为连续的, 输入条件相关性的分数注入注意记录, 轻而易举地将标记用于任务, 而不丢弃任何一项任务, (二) 注意行为锁定损失, 限制每个标记的注意输出 围绕特定类查询区域, 仅使用紧凑的高斯查询统计数据, 而不使用存储的旧图像, 按标记的过去相关性加权。 确定注意值可以使参数继续自由更新,只要其相互作用保持不变. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Continual learning (CL) requires a model to learn new knowledge from a stream of tasks without catastrophically forgetting [ 30 , 36 , 10 , 9 ] . With large pre-trained vision transformers [ 11 ] , prompt-based CL has become a leading rehearsal-free paradigm where the backbone is frozen to protect its general representations, and the adaptation is limited to a small set of learnable tokens [ 45 , 44 , 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 持续学习(CL)需要一个模式,从一系列任务中学习新知识,而不会灾难性地忘记[30、36、10、9]。 拥有大型预训视觉变压器[11],即时CL成为领先的无排练范式,将主干冻结起来以保护其总体表现,改造仅限于一小组可学习的符号[45,44,39].

blocks.en: Within this paradigm, most methods allocate task-specific prompts or expand prompt components as tasks arrive [ 44 , 39 , 41 , 16 , 20 ] , so prompt memory and selection cost grow linearly with the number of tasks. The opposite design, a single prompt shared across all tasks [ 19 , 23 ] , keeps parameters and compute constant regardless of the task count. It also highlights the main difficulty: When a shared prompt adapts to new tasks, what prevents it from forgetting old knowledge?
blocks.zh: 在这个范式中,大多数方法分配特定任务提示或扩展即时组件随着任务到达[44,39,41,16,20],因此快速内存和选择成本随任务数量而呈线性增长. 与此相反的设计,一个单一的即时共享所有任务[19,23],无论任务数多少,都保持参数和计算不变. 它还突出了主要困难: 当一个共享的瞬间适应新的任务时,是什么阻止它忘记旧知识?

blocks.en: Examining existing methods reveals a common pattern: they act in parameter space . (i) Isolation and freezing: task-specific prompts are frozen once their task ends [ 44 , 42 , 41 ] , and expansion-based methods freeze previous components while training new ones [ 39 ] . (ii) Selection sparsity: only retrieved prompts are updated in pool-based methods [ 45 ] , and sparse Top- K K gating over a decomposed shared prompt lets only the selected components receive gradients, complemented by a prototype loss on prompt keys [ 23 ] . Across these two families, the implicit assumption is the same: old knowledge is safe if and only if old parameters stay (nearly) where they were.
blocks.zh: 审视现有方法可以发现一种共同的模式:它们在参数空间中发挥作用。 (一) 隔离和冻结:任务特定提示一旦结束[44、42、41],即被冻结;扩展方法冻结以前的组件,同时培训新的组件[39]。 (二)选择sparsity:仅以池基方法更新检索的提示[45],在已分解的共享提示上稀释的Top-K gating,只允许选定组件获得梯度,辅以快速键的原型丢失[23]. 在整个这两个家族中,隐含的假设是相同的:老知识是安全的,只有老参数(接近)留在原地时才安全.

blocks.en: We argue this assumption is flawed on both sides. Firstly, it is too strong : Freezing and expansion tie stability to capacity, and sparse gating leaves unselected tokens idle. All paying in plasticity or parameters. Secondly, it is too weak : What an old class actually needs is that the prompt keeps producing the same attention contribution for its inputs. In classical CL, this is precisely the argument for regularizing in function space rather than weight space [ 4 , 40 ] , and attention-level preservation has proven effective for fully trainable ViTs [ 32 ] . Prompt-based CL, however, still lacks a function-space preservation mechanism. Even though, with a frozen backbone, the only source of attention drift is the prompt itself, making its behavior both necessary and sufficient object to protect.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这一假设在双方都有缺陷。 首先,它过于强大: 冰冻和扩张将稳定性与容量挂钩,稀疏的鳄鱼令未选的标志物闲置. 都以可塑性或参数支付. 第二,它太软弱了: 一个古老的阶级实际上需要的是,这个提示不断为其投入产生同样的关注贡献. 在古典CL中,这恰恰是函数空间而非重量空间规范化的论据[4,40],而注意级保全被证明对完全可训练的ViTs[32]有效. 然而,即时CL仍然缺乏功能空间保存机制。 虽然,有冰冻的骨干,唯一引人注意的漂移来源是迅速本身,使其行为既必要又足以保护对象.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose TEA-Prompt, which protects the shared prompt’s behavior rather than its parameters , through two coupled components. First, a token evaluation module treats the shared prompt as a set of key-value token pairs and assigns each token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score, computed from the correlation between the input query and the token’s key and passed through a sigmoid-based evaluation function. Injected as a penalty into the attention logits, the score lets relevant tokens dominate adaptation for the current input while attenuating the rest, inducing a soft, task-conditional specialization of tokens. Second, an attention-behavior anchoring loss stores compact class-wise Gaussian statistics of reduced queries. When learning new tasks, it samples queries from these distributions and penalizes deviations of each token’s attention output from its previous behavior. Crucially, the two components are coupled: the deviation of each token is weighted by its past relevance score, so preservation concentrates exactly on the tokens that mattered for old classes, while low-relevance tokens are free to adapt aggressively.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出TEA-Prompt,通过两个组合组件保护共同的快件行为而不是其参数。 首先,一个标志性评价模块将共享的提示作为一组密钥-值符对,并且根据输入查询和标志性密钥之间的关联性计算并传递到一个基于sigmoid的评价职能中,为每个标志指定一个连续的,输入-有条件的相关性分数. 作为罚注输入注目,分数让相关记号主导当前输入的适应,同时减轻其余部分,诱导符号的柔软,任务性专业化. 第二,关注行为锚定损失储存 紧凑 高斯统计 减少查询。 在学习新任务时,它会对这些分布的查询进行抽样,并惩罚每个符号的注意力输出偏离其先前的行为. 关键是,这两个部分是相配的:每个令牌的偏差都根据其过去的相关性分数进行加权,因此保存完全集中在对旧类重要的令牌上,而低相关性令牌则可以随意进行激烈的调整.

blocks.en: The main contributions of our work are as follows: • We recast anti-forgetting in shared-prompt CL as behavior preservation instead of parameter preservation , and instantiate it with a class-conditional, data-free attention anchoring loss using compact Gaussian query statistics and the previous prompt tokens. • We introduce a token evaluation module that assigns continuous, input-conditional relevance to each prompt token, softly specializing tokens across tasks to reduce cross-task interference; its stored past scores direct the anchoring loss toward the tokens where preservation matters. • Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200, including self-supervised backbones, show state-of-the-art accuracy and the lowest forgetting among shared-prompt methods at efficient parameter and compute cost.
blocks.zh: 我们工作的主要贡献如下: 我们在共享即时CL中将反遗忘重塑为行为保护而不是参数保护,并利用紧凑的高斯查询统计和之前的即时符号,用类条件的无数据关注锁定损失。 我们引入了一个标志性评价模块,该模块为每个迅速的标志指定持续、输入和有条件的关联性,在各项任务之间轻而易举地专门指定标志,以减少跨任务干扰;其存储的过去得分将锁定损失引向保存重要的标志。 • 对CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R和CUB-200进行广泛试验,包括自我监督的骨干,以高效参数和计算成本显示最新准确度和共享即时方法中最低的遗忘度。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Continual learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 继续学习

blocks.en: CL aims to incrementally acquire new knowledge while preserving previously learned information. The primary challenge in CL is catastrophic forgetting, where optimizing for new tasks leads to a severe decline in performance on earlier ones. To address this issue, traditional solutions are categorized into three main approaches: (1) regularization-based methods mitigate forgetting by introducing penalty terms that protect the weights critical to prior tasks [ 21 , 1 , 5 , 26 ] ; (2) replay-based methods maintain performance by either storing a subset of old data or using generative techniques to reconstruct past information [ 34 , 2 , 8 ] ; (3) architecture-based methods dynamically adjust the network structure or isolate specific parameter clusters to accommodate each new task [ 29 , 38 ] . While these methods have made significant strides, the emergence of pre-trained models [ 11 ] trained on massive datasets has triggered a paradigm shift. Recent trends have moved away from resource-intensive retraining toward parameter-efficient approaches (e.g., Prompt Tuning [ 24 ] , LoRA [ 18 ] ) and replay-free methods [ 45 , 44 , 39 ] , harnessing powerful pre-trained generalization capabilities for more efficient learning. These methods also differ in where to preserve: weight-space penalties [ 21 , 47 ] versus function-space constraints [ 26 , 4 , 40 ] . Our work brings the function-space perspective to prompt-based CL.
blocks.zh: CL旨在逐渐获得新知识,同时保存以前学到的信息. CL的主要挑战是灾难性的忘记,因为优化新任务会导致前一个任务的业绩严重下降。 为了解决这一问题,传统解决办法分为三个主要方法:(1) 基于规范化的方法通过引入保护对以前的任务至关重要的权重的处罚条款来缓解遗忘;(2) 基于重玩的方法通过存储一个旧数据子集或利用基因技术重建过去的信息来维持性能[34、2、8];(3) 基于结构的方法动态地调整网络结构或孤立特定参数集群以适应每一项新任务[29、38]。 虽然这些方法已取得重大进展,但经过大规模数据集培训的预先训练的模型[11]的出现引发了范式转变. 最近的趋势已经从资源密集型的再培训转向参数效率高的方法(例如,即时调用[24]、LORA[18])和无游戏方法[45、44、39],利用经过预先培训的强大通用能力,提高学习效率。 这些方法在保存地点方面也有所不同:重量空间处罚[21,47]与功能空间限制[26,4,40]。 我们的工作将函数空间视角带入了即时CL.

blocks.en: 2.2 Prompt-based continual learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 即时持续学习

blocks.en: L2P [ 45 ] pioneered prompt-based CL with a shared pool from which task-specific prompts are retrieved by key-query matching; DualPrompt [ 44 ] decomposes prompts into general and task-specific components attached at different layers; CODA-Prompt [ 39 ] replaces discrete retrieval with an attention-weighted composition over per-task components, enabling end-to-end optimization; VQ-Prompt [ 20 ] quantizes input-conditioned prompts into discrete codes, and further variants refine prompt evolution and consistency [ 16 , 14 , 41 ] . These methods perform strongly, but their prompt parameters and selection cost grow with the number of tasks. A second line keeps a single shared prompt: OVOR [ 19 ] pairs it with virtual-outlier regularization of the classifier, while SMoPE [ 23 ] views prefix tuning through a mixture-of-experts perspective.
blocks.zh: L2P [45] 以共享池为先导的即时CL,通过按键-query匹配从中检索特定任务提示; DualPrompt [44] 将提示分解为附加在不同层的一般和特定任务组件; CODA-Prompt [39] 将离散检索替换为每个任务组件的注意力加权组成,使端到端的优化成为可能; VQ-Prompt [20] 将输入条件化的提示分解为离散编码,并进一步完善了快速演变和一致性[16,14,41]. 这些方法表现强劲,但其迅速的参数和选择成本随着任务数量的增长而增加. 第二行保持单一共享的提示:OVOR [19] 将其与分类器的虚拟外置规范配对,而SMOPE [23] 则通过专家混合视角查看前缀调值.

blocks.en: Across both lines, forgetting is combated at the parameter level: task-specific prompts are frozen after their task [ 44 , 42 , 41 ] or previous components are frozen under expansion [ 39 ] ; or hard selection restricts which tokens receive gradients at all [ 45 , 23 ] . None of these directly constrains what the prompt does on previously seen classes. On the contrary, our method protects the behavior of token that correlated to the old task and provides a smooth token evaluation to maintain the ability of learning new tasks.
blocks.zh: 在两条线上,在参数一级与遗忘作斗争:任务特定提示在任务[44、42、41]或以前的组件在扩展[39]下被冻结;或者硬选择限制,使符号得到梯度[45、23]。 这些都没有直接限制对以前看到的班级的及时性。 相反,我们的方法保护了与旧任务相关的象征性行为,并提供了一个平稳的象征性评价,以保持学习新任务的能力.

blocks.en: 2.3 Preserving behavior versus parameters
blocks.zh: 2.3 保留行为与参数

blocks.en: Function-level preservation has a long history in CL: LwF distills output logits [ 26 ] , PodNet distills pooled intermediate features [ 12 ] , and continual distillation has recently been explored in prompt-based CL across teacher-student models [ 48 ] . These objectives operate at the task level and require a stored teacher copy evaluated on current-task data. Closer to our target, Pelosin et al . [ 32 ] distill pooled pre-softmax attention maps between consecutive, fully trainable ViTs for exemplar-free CL, establishing attention as an effective lever against forgetting. Our loss differs in scope and machinery: with a frozen backbone, we anchor only the prompt tokens’ attention outputs by storing class-based Gaussian query statistics, requiring neither old data nor a network copy, with the constraint weighted by each token’s past relevance.
blocks.zh: 函数级保存在CL中历史悠久:LwF蒸馏输出日志[26],PodNet蒸馏集合中间特征[12],最近通过跨师生模式的快速CL探索持续蒸馏[48]. 这些目标在任务层面运作,需要根据当前任务数据评估存储的教师副本。 离我们的目标更近,Pelosin等人.[32]在连续的,完全可以训练的ViTs之间分馏集合的软体前注意力图,以示无症状的CL,确立注意力是防止遗忘的有效杠杆. 我们的损失在范围和机制上各不相同:由于骨干被冻结,我们只能通过存储基于阶级的高斯查询统计来锁定即时信号的注意产出,既不需要旧数据,也不需要网络副本,限制值按每个信号的过去相关性加权计算。

blocks.en:
Sequential training drifts the attention behavior of the shared prompt, which is the main cause of forgetting. Prior methods constrain prompt parameters: Weights are regularized toward, or grown alongside,
their past values. TEA-Prompt instead anchors prompt
behavior: What the prompt tokens contribute to attention when
queried from the representation space occupied by past
classes (Fig. 1 , right). The anchor is rehearsal-free, only stores compact per-class query statistics and one snapshot of the prompt.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和执行细节

blocks.en: Datasets. To evaluate TEA-Prompt performance, we perform comprehensive image classification in the class-incremental learning settings using three primary benchmarks: CIFAR-100 [ 22 ] , ImageNet-R [ 15 ] , and CUB-200 [ 46 ] . CIFAR-100 (100 classes) serves as a standard benchmark for prompt-based CL to evaluate generalization. ImageNet-R is selected for its inherent difficulty, containing 200 classes with diverse artistic styles and high intra-class variance. Finally, we utilize the fine-grained CUB-200 dataset of 200 bird species to test the model’s ability to distinguish subtle inter-class differences. Across all experiments, each dataset is partitioned into 10 tasks with disjoint classes: 20 classes/task for ImageNet-R, 10 classes/task for CIFAR-100, and 20 classes/task for CUB-200.

ImageNet-R因其内在难度而入选,包含200个班级,艺术风格多样,班内差异较大. 最后,我们利用200种鸟类的精细CUB-200数据集来测试模型区分细微的阶级间差异的能力。 在所有实验中,每个数据集被分为10个与分门别类的任务:20个班/任务用于ImageNet-R,10个班/任务用于CIFAR-100,20个班/任务用于CUB-200。

blocks.en: Compared methods. We evaluate the performance of TEA-Prompt against a comprehensive suite of methods, including non-prompt-based methods such as LAE [ 13 ] , InfLoRA [ 27 ] , and EASE [ 49 ] , as well as established prompt-based architectures: L2P [ 45 ] , DualPrompt [ 44 ] , CODA-Prompt [ 39 ] , OVOR-Deep [ 19 ] , ESN [ 43 ] , RainbowPrompt [ 16 ] , CPrompt [ 14 ] , VQ-Prompt [ 20 ] , and SMoPE [ 23 ] . The results are reproduced based on the original setting in these works.
blocks.zh: 比较方法. 我们对照一整套方法评价TEA-Prompt的性能,包括非即时方法,如LAE [13],InfLORA [27],和EASE [49],以及既定的即时架构:L2P [45],DualPrompt [44],CODA-Prompt [39],OVOR-Deep [19],ESN [43],彩虹Prompt [16],CPrompt [14],VQ-Prompt [20],和SMOPE [23]. 研究结果是根据这些作品的原始设定转载的。

blocks.en: Implementation details. All experiments are executed on a NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. Following [ 16 , 45 ] , we primarily use the pre-trained ViT-B/16 on ImageNet-1K [ 37 ] and ImageNet-21K [ 35 ] as our backbone. TEA-Prompt is optimized using the AdamW optimizer [ 28 ] with a cosine learning rate decay schedule to stabilize training. For the training configurations, we employ a batch size of 64 for ImageNet-R, while a larger batch size of 128 is utilized for both CIFAR-100 and CUB-200. Besides, the classifier in CL tends to favor recently added classes, leading to biased predictions [ 17 , 3 ] . To mitigate this effect, we apply a simple task adaptive prediction (TAP) technique inspired by [ 20 , 41 ] . The model predictions are adjusted using feature statistics from previously learned classes, which helps rebalance old and new categories and stabilizes prompt learning throughout training.

TEA-Prompt是使用亚当W优化器[28]进行优化,并配有余弦学习速率衰减表以稳定训练. 在培训配置方面,我们采用64个分批规模的ImageNet-R,而CIFAR-100和CUB-200则使用128个分批规模。 此外,CL中的分类者往往倾向于最近增加的分类,导致偏颇的预测[17,3]. 为了减轻这种影响,我们采用了[20,41]启发的简单任务适应预测技术。 模型预测使用以前学习班的特征统计进行调整,这有助于重新平衡新旧类别,稳定整个培训过程中的快速学习。

blocks.en:
Results on three benchmarks
are summarized in Table 1 . • CIFAR-100: On this standard benchmark, TEA-Prompt achieves notable performance with an average accuracy of 90.59%, which lies a mere 0.79% below the upper bound. When compared with SMoPE, which relies on sparse Top- K K selection over a shared prompt structure, TEA-Prompt yields a 1.73% improvement in accuracy while reducing the forgetting rate from 4.57% down to 2.68% with the same number of parameters. This clear margin demonstrates that our continuous token evaluation can address the rigidity of discrete token selection
by exploiting complementary information from lower-ranked tokens. Furthermore, TEA-Prompt outperforms recent weighted prompt composition methods such as VQ-Prompt (88.73%) and CODA-Prompt (86.92%), suggesting the superior efficacy of our rehearsal-free loss in mitigating forgetting without requiring access to past training samples. • ImageNet-R: On the challenging ImageNet-R dataset, characterized by severe distribution shifts and high intra-class variance across diverse artistic styles, TEA-Prompt achieves the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with an average accuracy (Avg Acc) of 77.40% and a forgetting rate of 4.19%. Furthermore, when compared to OVOR, a method utilizing a shared prompt architecture, our method reduces the forgetting rate by approximately 3% but remains a small number of trainable parameters. This further underscores the effectiveness of TEA-Prompt in mitigating forgetting within challenging scenarios. • CUB-200: On the CUB-200 fine-grained classification dataset, while OVOR struggled with classification, achieving an accuracy of only 78.11%, TEA-Prompt boosted accuracy to 86.84%, despite sharing the same shared-prompt architecture. Meanwhile, although SMoPE achieved good accuracy, it exhibited a relatively high forgetting rate of 5.61%. We attribute this to the fact that while their anti-forgetting mechanism employs a prototype loss function to preserve old prefix keys, the prefix values remain susceptible to drift, resulting in an incomplete distillation process. In contrast, by preserving prior knowledge through the anchoring of attention behaviors for old tokens, TEA-Prompt achieved better resistance to forgetting, with a rate of only 3.30%. This result suggests that our method can handle forgetting under different circumstances, from standard benchmark such as CIFAR-100 to fine-grained dataset such as CUB-200.

三个基准的结果
• CIFAR-100: 在这个标准基准上,TEA-Prompt取得了显著的性能,平均精度为90.59%,仅低于上限0.79%. 与依赖稀疏的Top-K K选择而不是共享的即时结构的SMOPE相比,TEA-Prompt的精度提高了1.73%,同时将遗忘率从4.57%降低到2.68%,参数相同. 这种明确的差值表明,我们不断的象征性评价可以解决离散象征性选择的僵硬性问题。
利用排名较低的标志的补充信息。 此外,TEA-Prompt的性能超过了最近的加权即时组成方法,如VQ-Prompt(88.73%)和CODA-Prompt(86.92%),这表明我们的无排练损失在减轻遗忘方面的效果更好,而不需要查阅过去的培训样本。 · ImageNet-R:在具有挑战性的ImageNet-R数据集上,以不同艺术风格之间的严重分布转变和高等级内部差异为特征,TEA-Prompt以平均精度(Avg Acc)77.40%和遗忘率4.19%的成绩实现了最新水平(SOTA). 此外,与使用共享即时架构的OVOR方法相比,我们的方法将遗忘率降低约3%,但仍是少数可训练参数。 这进一步突出了TEA-Prompt在挑战性情景中减轻遗忘的效果。 • CUB-200: 在CUB-200精细的分类数据集上,OVOR在分类中挣扎,只实现了78.11%的精度,TEA-Prompt将精度提升到86.84%,尽管共享了相同的共享即时架构. 同时,虽然SMoPE取得了良好的准确性,但它的遗忘率相对较高,为5.61%。 我们将此归因于:虽然他们的抗遗忘机制使用原型丢失功能来保存旧的前缀键,但前缀值仍然容易漂移,导致蒸馏过程不完整. 与此相反,TEA-Prompt通过将注意力行为锁定在旧的代币上来保存先前的知识,实现了更好的阻力,避免遗忘,只有3.30%的速率. 这一结果表明,我们的方法可以处理在不同情况下的遗忘问题,从CIFAR-100等标准基准到CUB-200等精细刻度数据集.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we recast anti-forgetting for shared-prompt continual learning as a problem of preserving the prompt’s behavior rather than its parameters. TEA-Prompt couples a token evaluation module, assigning a continuous, input-conditional relevance score to every prompt token, with an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains token attention outputs around class-specific Gaussian query statistics, weighted by past relevance so that preservation concentrates where it mattered. Extensive experiments on standard class-incremental benchmarks show that TEA-Prompt consistently outperforms strong prompt-based baselines across datasets and pre-trained backbones while keeping parameters and compute independent of the task count. These results validate relevance-guided behavior anchoring as a scalable, rehearsal-free route to continual learning with pre-trained models.
blocks.zh: 在这份论文中,我们把反遗忘作为共同的即兴持续学习的问题,作为保留“迅速”行为而不是其参数的问题。 TEA-Prompt配对一个符号评价模块,为每个即时符号分配一个连续的,输入条件相关性的分数,并有一个关注-行为锁定损失,它约束着围绕特定类高斯查询统计的象征性关注产出,并按过去的相关性进行加权,使保存集中在重要的地方. 对标准等级递增基准的广泛试验显示,TEA-Prompt在保持参数和计算独立于任务计数的同时,始终超越了数据集和预先训练的骨干之间的强速基线。 这些结果验证了关联性指导行为锚定作为可伸缩的,无排练的路线,以预先训练过的模型持续学习.

blocks.en:
There are two natural concerns regarding the continuous weighting mechanism: either it causes a small number of tokens to dominate (leading to collapse), or it maintains partial activation for all tokens across all inputs, resulting in cross-task interference.
Figures 2 and 3 demonstrate that TEA-Prompt avoids these two issues.
When aggregating results across all tasks and attention heads, every prompt token receives an above-threshold activation rate that is remarkably uniform (Figure 2 ), without suffering from load-balancing issues. However, within the scope of a specific task, the evaluation weights concentrate attention on a select few tokens while reducing attention on the others
(Figure 3 ). Thus, we can conclude that there is stability in token activation alongside specialization as tokens adapt to specific inputs, thereby mitigating cross-task interference.

The reduced query 𝐪 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{q}} plays a dual role in TEA-Prompt:
it is the input of the token evaluation module, and it is the variable whose class-conditional Gaussian statistics drive the anchoring loss . For the first role, instance-level evaluation is equivalent to the prompt-attention score aggregation of SMoPE [ 23 ] ,
which provably preserves the sample complexity of prompt estimation and empirically matches the convergence of
standard prefix tuning. We therefore do not re-evaluate that design
choice and focus on the impact of it on our anchoring loss ℒ AD \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AD}} . Table 9 compares the variations observed when using the reduced query 𝐪 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{q}} versus the raw query 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} . Due to linearity, both variants share the same class cluster centers; they differ only in terms of dispersion, even memory is the same. This ”dilution” reduces stability, thereby impairing memorization capability. Thus, 𝐪 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{q}} enhances the statistical quality of the data ”anchor,” rather than merely offering convenience during the collection process.

blocks.en: More complex density models offer no benefit: a Gaussian distribution with a full covariance matrix and a two-component diagonal Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM-2) yield accuracy comparable to a diagonal Gaussian without improving resistance to forgetting, while incurring up to 24% higher computational costs per step (2.72 GFLOPS vs 2.19 GFLOPS). Completely removing the variance component (retaining only the mean) is the least expensive option but compromises accuracy. Using a single fixed probe per class fails to cover the entire query region that needs to be preserved. This confirms that the distribution of samples holds the signal for anchoring information rather than just the class center. Consequently, the diagonal Gaussian achieves an optimal balance between accuracy and cost. Nevertheless, this total cost remains a small fraction of the forward pass for a single image, enabling TEA-Prompt to achieve strong performance in the single shared prompt scenario.
blocks.zh: 更复杂的密度模型没有好处:高斯分布式,具有完全的共变矩阵和两部分对角高斯混合模型(GMM-2),在不提高遗忘阻力的情况下,得出与对角高斯模型相当的精度,同时每步计算成本高达24%(2.72 GFLOPS vs 2.19 GFLOPS)。 完全去除差异部分(仅保留平均值)是最便宜的选择,但会降低准确性。 每类使用单个固定探测器无法覆盖需要保存的整个查询区域. 这证实,样品的分发具有锁定信息的信号,而不仅仅是阶级中心. 因此,对角高斯琴在准确性和成本之间实现了最佳平衡。 尽管如此,这一总成本仍然是单一图像前进通道的一小部分,使TEA-Prompt能够在单一共享即时情景下实现强效.
